abstractPattern: Dormitory sample step fields are declared as inherited, user-selectable, derived, backend-default, or retired fields. This is a reusable Definition pattern for other business domains: later WorkItems must not ask users to manually type object references, actor/person fields, generated ids, derived values, or hidden defaults. Surfaces render inherited fields read-only or hidden-submit, derived fields as preview/hidden-submit, user fields as the only editable fields, backend defaults as hidden/no-client-trust fields, and retired fields as suppressed retired fields.

fieldBuckets.inheritedFields: system context from prior WorkItems, runtime events, projections, operations-start-context payloads, session, assignment chain, or completed records
fieldBuckets.userSelectableFields: the fields the current operator can actually decide or correct in this step
fieldBuckets.derivedFields: values generated from inherited/user fields and recomputed when inputs change
fieldBuckets.backendDefaultFields: runtime/session/default values owned by backend; frontend never asks the user to type them
fieldBuckets.retiredFields: retired or misleading fields that must be hidden instead of accepted as current user input

hiddenBackendDefaults.reason: backend runtime owns this default; client must not ask the user to type it

retiredFields.reason: retired by current step dependency contract; kept only to suppress stale retired WorkItem fields

guardPolicy.rule: If a later dormitory WorkItem exposes one of these protected fields, it must declare the field as inherited, derived, backendDefault, retired, or explicitly userSelectable in this contract; otherwise the Definition Registry guard fails. Submit-before-check summaries may show only user-actionable missing fields by default.
